<documents>
<document id="atm-network">
Finding a BrookLink ATM
BrookLink is our ATM network. Withdrawals at BrookLink ATMs are free on every plan ($0.00 from us, and the ATM owner doesn't add a surcharge).

## Find a BrookLink ATM

Open the app, tap Cash, then ATM map. The map shows BrookLink ATMs near you with opening hours, since some are inside stores.

## Using other ATMs

You can use any ATM that accepts Visa. Outside BrookLink, you may pay an out-of-network fee depending on your plan, and the ATM owner may add a surcharge. The ATM screen should show the owner's surcharge before you confirm.

## Daily limits

ATM withdrawals count toward a daily ATM limit that depends on your plan. See "ATM withdrawal limits".

## Depositing cash

BrookLink ATMs don't take cash deposits. To add cash, use a participating retail store instead. See "Depositing cash at a store".

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.
</document>
<document id="atm-surcharges">
ATM owner surcharges and our fees
When you use an ATM outside BrookLink, up to two different charges can apply. They're easy to mix up.

## The ATM owner's surcharge

This is set by whoever owns the ATM, not by us. The ATM shows it on screen before you confirm, and it's added to the withdrawal amount. For example, if you withdraw cash and the owner charges a surcharge, one transaction for the total appears in your activity.

## Tallowbrook's out-of-network fee

This is our fee, charged as a separate line called "Out-of-network ATM fee". It's $2.50 on Basic and on Plus after your free withdrawals, and free on Premium.

## Premium surcharge reimbursement

Premium pays back ATM owner surcharges up to $10.00 per calendar month. The refund is credited automatically on the first business day of the next month.

## Avoiding both

Use a BrookLink ATM. They never charge a surcharge, and we never charge a fee for them.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.
</document>
<document id="fees-schedule-basic-v2">
Basic plan fee schedule
Here is every fee that can apply to a Basic account, effective March 1, 2026. Fees are taken from your main balance when they're charged and show up in your activity feed with the word "Fee".

| Fee | Amount |
|---|---|
| Monthly fee | $0.00 |
| Out-of-network ATM withdrawal | $2.50 |
| International ATM withdrawal | $3.00 |
| Foreign transaction fee | 3% |
| Card replacement | $5.00 |
| Expedited card shipping | $25.00 |
| Outgoing domestic wire | $25.00 |
| Outgoing international wire | not available |
| Incoming international wire | $10.00 |
| Cash deposit at a retail store | $3.00 |

## Details

BrookLink ATMs are always free. The out-of-network fee applies to every withdrawal at any other ATM in the US.

Outgoing international wires aren't available on this plan.

No plan has overdraft fees, returned transfer fees or inactivity fees. The monthly fee is charged on your billing date and isn't prorated.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: Can I deposit cash at a BrookLink ATM?
